name: Compact Robotic Pivot
description: The pivot has a range of motion of 0.25 turns in both directions. A standard input value sets the target orientation within the pivot's range of motion. The pivot's speed can be configured by selecting it with the select tool.
shortDescription: A small robotic pivot that will orientate towards the input value within its range of motion.

logicNodes.label: Rotation Target
logicNodes.description: The standard value setting the orientation within the range of motion.
